bio: Located on the first floor of the grandiose 19C Geozavod edifice, this opulent, aristocratic restaurant occupies one of Belgrade’s most eye-catching, iconic landmarks, whose marble, stucco, brass and gilt decor creates a glitzy special occasion vibe. In this sumptuous setting, the young chef crafts a high-flying culinary repertory, depicted by consummate execution and exquisite plating. The goal is to highlight top-drawer Serbian produce and thoroughbred recipes, all of which viewed through a contemporary lens. There is no à la carte menu; instead, guests are invited to enjoy a surprise tasting menu, with the only choice being the number of courses....
